create_act_instance: create an Act instance with a specified activation function name and optional slope parameter
apply_relu_activation: apply the ReLU activation function to a PyTorch tensor using the Act class
apply_leaky_activations: apply leaky variants of softplus, ELU, or tanh activations with a configurable slope
apply_shifted_softplus: apply the shifted softplus activation by subtracting log(2) from the softplus output
apply_swish_activation: apply the swish activation function by multiplying sigmoid with the input tensor
